HOLD at medium conviction pending the dual gate close; BUY upgrade conditional on today's dual close AND Goldilocks NFP (90–130K, wages +0.2–0.3%).

bear_case: The ISM Manufacturing 54.0 print carries an embedded inflation cost: May's Prices Paid component stood at 82.1, and a similarly elevated June reading would confirm that manufacturing expansion is occurring alongside input cost acceleration — exactly the stagflationary profile that gives Warsh's FOMC cover for three hikes. The 10Y yield has already risen 10bps to 4.47% on the ISM data, indicating markets are pricing the beat as inflationary, not purely growth-positive. At Nasdaq P/E ~28x, the 10Y at 4.47% compresses the relative-return math even before NFP lands. BTC at $58,662 — declining on the first ISM expansion session of Q3 — confirms speculative capital remains in distribution mode. An NFP print above 150K through a 3-day unhedgeable gap at these multiples is a scenario where the ISM-driven rally of July 1 reverses before the market can react. Invalidation: SPX holds above 7,460 through today's close, VIX closes below 17 simultaneously, and tomorrow's NFP prints Goldilocks (90–130K, wages +0.2–0.3%) — that sequence confirms the regime upgrade with multi-week BUY conviction into Q3 earnings season (GOOGL, META, MSFT, AMZN all reporting mid-to-late July).
